observations: Photo 0 shows a car engine bay/engine assembly on the ground with visible alternator, belt/pulleys, hoses, and wiring harness.
No clear Toyota badge, engine code, VIN plate, or model year marking is readable in the photo.
The photo does not show compression test results, leak test, or any running condition.

claims.claim: Toyota camry Engine 5x old model direct with guarantee
claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show a readable Toyota/Camry identification, engine code, or any guarantee documentation.

risks.risk: Engine may not be from a Toyota Camry (or may be a different engine variant) — the photo doesn’t show engine code/ID.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine identification plate/engine code (e.g., stamped code on block) plus the full engine label area.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unidentified used engine (worst case: not confirmed compatible), with no guarantee assumed.

risks.risk: “Old model” and “direct” are not verifiable; mileage/condition could be worse than stated.
risks.proof: Photo/video of the engine running (cold start if possible) and a dashboard/ECU scan showing mileage/health (or service records).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used engine with unknown mileage and unknown internal condition (worst case: needs overhaul).

risks.risk: “With guarantee” is not shown; could be unenforceable or limited.
risks.proof: A written guarantee terms photo (duration, what is covered/excluded) and seller ID/contact details.

risks.risk: Possible missing parts/damage not visible in this single angle (hoses, sensors, brackets, timing components).
risks.proof: Full 360° photos of the engine from multiple angles, including front timing area, top cover area, and underside; plus a checklist of included parts.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst case: buyer may need to source missing parts).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the engine code/ID stamped on the block (and any Toyota/Camry markings) — photo must be readable.
Video of the engine running (or at least a start-up test) showing smooth idle and no abnormal smoke/noise.
Written guarantee terms (duration, coverage, exclusions) and seller contact details.
Full set of photos: top, sides, front timing area, rear, and underside; confirm all sensors/belts/pulleys and what is included.
response.reason: From photo 0, the engine’s exact identity (Toyota Camry variant/engine code) and condition (running status, mileage, completeness) are not verifiable, so a safe worst-case price can’t be set without the key identifying and proof shots.
